  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential models"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Select a model"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify company in time"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EndOfPeriod" name="End of leave period">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_EndOfPeriod"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extension decision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Extend" name="Decision to extend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="Decision not to extend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_EndOfPeriod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_EndOfPeriod" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Extend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Do not extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description presents process activities in a stated order: Model the corresponding flow nodes in that order with sequence flows, connecting the start event to the initial activity and the final activity to the end event.
rules.situation: the description presents process activities in a stated order

rules.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules.situation: the description states a decision or outcome but does not specify its alternatives

rules.instruction: When the description states that a real-world activity is carried out over a period before a later decision: Model the activity as a BPMN task; a time event may mark the period’s end but does not replace the activity.
rules.situation: the description states that a real-world activity is carried out over a period before a later decision

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome whose surrounding context is already clear from the process flow: Use a concise BPMN label that preserves the activity or outcome, without adding explanatory context that does not distinguish it from other elements.
rules.situation: the description states a decision or outcome without naming additional alternatives

rules.instruction: When the description lists multiple actions in an order and does not indicate that they occur concurrently or independently: Model the actions in the stated order using sequence flows; do not use parallel branches unless the description supports concurrent or independent execution.
rules.situation: the description presents activities in a stated temporal order, or makes an action dependent on an earlier action or on a period ending.
